text:
Maya: Heads-up: Prospect Aperture wants a short POC (5 days) using their in-house model 'Aperture-28B' with fp16 and 4-bit variants. They asked for Dedicated + VPC peering and token-level billing visibility. Can SE/infra/sec confirm feasibility and blockers?

Jon: Need repo link and license. Is tokenizer SentencePiece or HuggingFace BPE? Also confirm whether they want us to pull from their S3 or upload to our blob.

Maya: Repo: https://git.example/aperture/aperture-28b tag release-2026-03. Tokenizer: sentencepiece. They uploaded checkpoints in PyTorch format. License file ambiguous (mentions "research use").

Priya: Security/legal: if license restricts commercial hosting that's a blocker. We can request a hosting waiver for the POC or do an on-prem run. Also require their SOC2 summary and IP CIDR for peering.

Jon: Quick runtime probe commands I'm running now:
```
git clone https://git.example/aperture/aperture-28b /tmp/aperture
python tools/check_spm.py --model /tmp/aperture --prompt "Hello"
python tools/runtime_probe.py --model /tmp/aperture --dtype fp16 --seq 256
```

infra-bot: ticket AP-10234 created: "Aperture-28B presales compatibility" assigned to @jon, watchers: @priya, @ken, @maya.

Jon: Initial findings: tokenizer loads but uses legacy spm normalizer; we'll map to our normalizer. Forward pass fails at kv-cache layout (seq,heads,hdim) vs expected (heads,seq,hdim). I can add a tiny adapter shim in runtime. Opening a PR.

Ken: Sizing: FP16 -> recommend 2xA100-80GB for stable throughput; 4-bit might fit on single A100 with sharding but requires quality validation. POC infra estimate ~3.8k USD for 5 days + ops hours for quant.

Priya: License file is LICENSE-RESEARCH.md. Sent legal note to the customer asking for a commercial POC license or explicit hosting waiver. If they decline, propose an on-prem option with higher fees and a short MSA addendum.

Maya: Action items: Jon -> runtime adapter PR + FP16 smoke run; Ken -> provisional Dedicated pool & cost note; Priya -> SQA + license follow-up; I'll update customer. Target update tomorrow AM. :calendar:
